paper_citation: Lake, B.B. et al. An atlas of healthy and injured cell states and niches in the human kidney. Nature 619, 585–594 (2023).
notes: Gold claims are scorer-only. Agents must never see this file.

claims.statement: Injured human kidney epithelium adopts discrete cycling, transitioning, adaptive (successful or maladaptive repair), and degenerative states, especially within proximal tubule and thick ascending limb subclasses.
Adaptive / injured tubular states co-localize with distinct immune-active cellular niches (including myeloid / neutrophil neighbourhoods) linking epithelial injury to local immune responses.
Molecular signatures of epithelial repair / maladaptive states associate with decline in kidney function and can be mapped onto histological injury regions together with stromal (aFIB) expansion.
